card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted spots, mostly in drug-interaction sentences, such as after 'have' before 'dopamine', inside names like propranolol, or on 'when' and 'C' in CYP2C9.
card.plain: It lights up at scattered, unrelated spots in drug-interaction text, with no pattern a reader could rely on.
